notes.title: Rhythm of Resistance is the "world's first" rhythm metroidvania
notes.content:
I'm not entirely sure if their announcement of it being the "world's first" truly holds up, but I can't say I've seen anything like Rhythm of Resistance.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/rhythm-of-resistance-is-the-worlds-first-rhythm-metroidvania/
